summary: This Standards Track document deprecates two key exchanges for (D)TLS 1.2, finite-field Diffie-Hellman and RSA, and discourages static ECDH cipher suites. It applies only to (D)TLS 1.2. It updates many RFCs, including RFC 5246 and RFC 9325.

eli5.summary: Some old locks have known weaknesses, so builders are told to stop using them.
